en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing an arched bridge over a river with railings and pedestrians, leading towards a small town nestled at the base of a steep, rocky hill or mountain. Traditional houses and a tree‑lined street are visible at the far end of the bridge. Text is printed in the white margin below the image, including the town name and a caption describing the bridge and surrounding landscape.
